{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year = 2020–21 |team = Syracuse Orange |sport = Basketball |image = Syracuse Orange logo.svg |image_size = 100px |conference = Atlantic Coast Conference |division = |short_conf = ACC |record = 18–10 |conf_record = 9–7 |CoachRank = 25 |APRank = |head_coach = [[Jim Boeheim]] |hc_year = 45th |asst_coach1 = [[Adrian Autry]] |asst_coach2 = [[Gerry McNamara]] |asst_coach3 = Allen Griffin |stadium = [[Carrier Dome]] |champion = |tourney = [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Sweet Sixteen | off_scheme = Ball-Screen Motion | def_scheme = 2-3 Zone }} {{2020–21 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team''' represented [[Syracuse University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Orange were led by 45th-year head coach [[Jim Boeheim]] and played their home games at the [[Carrier Dome]] in [[Syracuse, New York]] as eighth-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Orange finished the season 18–10, 9–7 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in eight place. In the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] in the second round before losing to [[2020–21 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] in the Quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as an eleven seed in the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament#Midwest Regional|Midwest Region]]. In the tournament, they defeated six seed [[2020–21 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] in the first round and three seed [[2020–21 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]] in the second round, before losing to two seed [[2020–21 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the Sweet Sixteen. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Orange]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 18–14, 10–10 in ACC play to finish in a tie for sixth place. They defeated [[2019–20 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the second round of the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|2020 ACC tournament]] and was scheduled to play [[2019–20 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] in the quarterfinals before the tournament was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |title=Statement from ACC on Men's Basketball Tournament |url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/12/statement-from-acc-on-mens-basketball-tournament.aspx |website=theacc.com |publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference |accessdate=12 March 2020}} The [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and [[2020 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] were also cancelled due to the pandemic.{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships|title=NCAA cancels remaining winter and spring championships|last=|first=|date=|website=|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200312202043/http://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships |archive-date=2020-03-12 |access-date=}} ==Offseason== === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" style="text-align:center;" !
